messages:
Mara Chen: Quick UX check on Roles matrix — rows get huge when people have many roles. Thinking: compact chip mode + +N overflow, sticky Invite button.

Joel Patel: +1 compact mode. For +N, prefer popover anchored to +N so layout doesn't jump. Popover should trap focus.

Priya Singh: A11y: ensure +N is focusable and announced as "X more roles". Popover needs aria-expanded and keyboard escape. Also ensure contrast for chip text.

Aaron Li: Backend: we can add flag ff_roles_compact and telemetry roles_compact_used. CSV invites: add "View import errors" action in success toast linking to /orgs/:org/imports/:id/errors returning [{row:3,email:'x@y',error:'duplicate'}].

Mara Chen: Small copy tweak: change CTA to "Invite people" when multiple emails allowed. We'll dogfood compact behind flag first. Leaving notes in the spec doc. :thumbsup:
